items.label: Patient identity, procedure, and site confirmed with the patient
Consent verified
Surgical site marked (where applicable)
Anaesthesia machine and medication check completed
Pulse oximeter attached and functioning
Known allergies reviewed
Difficult airway or aspiration risk assessed, with equipment/help available if needed
Risk of significant blood loss assessed, with IV access/fluids/blood planned accordingly

source.title: Surgical Safety Checklist — Sign In phase

items.label: All team members introduced by name and role
Patient name, procedure, and incision site confirmed aloud by the whole team
Antibiotic prophylaxis given within the appropriate window (or explicitly not indicated)
Anticipated critical or unusual steps discussed by the surgical team
Anaesthesia team's concerns for this patient discussed
Sterility of instruments confirmed (including indicator results)
Essential imaging displayed, where relevant

title: Surgical Safety — Sign Out
phase: Before the patient leaves the operating room

items.label: Procedure performed is recorded
Instrument, sponge, and needle counts confirmed correct
Specimens labelled correctly, including patient name
Any equipment problems identified and flagged for follow-up
Key concerns for recovery and post-operative management communicated to the receiving team

source.organization: Seed placeholder (structured after published surgical safety checklist concepts)
source.title: Surgical Safety Checklist — Sign Out phase

title: Anaesthesia Machine Check
phase: Before the first case of the day

items.label: Power supply and backup battery checked
Gas supply pressures (pipeline and backup cylinders) checked
Breathing circuit checked for leaks and correct assembly
Scavenging system connected and functioning
Vaporizers checked for fill level and correct seating
Self-inflating bag and alternative means of ventilation available
Suction tested and functioning
Monitors calibrated/checked (SpO2, capnography, NIBP, ECG, temperature)
Airway equipment and emergency drugs checked and immediately available
Neuromuscular block adequately reversed (clinically and/or by quantitative monitoring)
Patient breathing spontaneously with adequate tidal volumes
Haemodynamically stable
Protective airway reflexes returning (swallow/cough)
Adequate analgesia and normothermia
Suction and airway rescue equipment immediately available
Plan agreed for a difficult airway if re-intubation is needed

title: Sepsis Hour-1 Bundle
phase: Within 1 hour of sepsis/septic shock recognition

items.label: Measure lactate (repeat if initial lactate >2 mmol/L)
Obtain blood cultures before starting antibiotics
Administer broad-spectrum antibiotics
Begin rapid administration of 30 mL/kg crystalloid for hypotension or lactate ≥4 mmol/L
Apply vasopressors if hypotensive during or after fluid resuscitation to maintain MAP ≥65 mmHg
Reassess volume status and tissue perfusion after initial resuscitation

source.organization: Seed placeholder (structured after Surviving Sepsis Campaign Hour-1 bundle concept)
source.title: Sepsis Hour-1 Bundle — core elements

items.label: Feeding — nutrition plan reviewed
Analgesia — pain adequately controlled
Sedation — target RASS reviewed, daily interruption considered
Thromboprophylaxis — DVT prophylaxis ordered/appropriate
Head-of-bed elevation 30–45° (if not contraindicated)
Ulcer (stress) prophylaxis reviewed
Glucose control reviewed
Mobility — early mobilization considered
Antibiotics — indication, day count, de-escalation reviewed
Indwelling catheters/lines — necessity reviewed, remove if not needed
De-escalation — overall care plan and goals reviewed
Spontaneous breathing trial readiness screened (if ventilated)

source.title: Daily ICU rounds checklist — core elements

title: CRRT Circuit Setup & Initiation
phase: Before starting continuous renal replacement therapy

items.label: Indication for CRRT confirmed and documented
Vascular access (dialysis catheter) patency confirmed
Modality selected (CVVH / CVVHD / CVVHDF)
Target effluent dose prescribed (mL/kg/hr)
Anticoagulation strategy selected (citrate / systemic heparin / none) with monitoring plan
Baseline electrolytes, calcium, coagulation profile sent
Fluid balance/removal target for the shift set
Alarm limits and circuit pressures checked at initiation
